title: Hardship Assistance Cap and the Customer's Payment Record (Ostomy Supply Program)
content:
The assistance cap replaces the default cap in the cap room of an Ostomy Supply Program financial-hardship waiver and follows the customer's payment record over the last 12 months: the patient payments posted on the program whose posting date is fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the day the waiver is worked out.

| Payments posted on the program in the last 12 months | Assistance cap |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | USD 150.00 (the regular-payer cap) |
| 3 to 5 | USD 100.00 (the some-payments cap) |
| Fewer than 3 | USD 60.00 (the default cap) |

The cap room is the cap less the hardship waivers already counted against it, never below zero, and the waiver base of the named posting is taken up to that room.

**Boundaries (hypothetical).** Two payments: USD 60.00. Three payments: USD 100.00. Five payments: USD 100.00. Six payments: USD 150.00. With a USD 150.00 cap and USD 40.00 of hardship waivers already counted against it, the cap room is USD 110.00.
